snippets.instruction: Convert a string to a cstring and delete it
targets:
str: string = "Hello!"
cstr := strings.clone_to_cstring(str)
rl.DrawText(cstr, 50, 50, 10, rl.WHITE)
delete(cstr)

total: string = "timber"
amount := strings.clone_to_cstring(total)
rl.DrawText(amount, 200, 200, 7, rl.WHITE)
delete(amount)

amount: string = "widget"
item := strings.clone_to_cstring(amount)
rl.DrawText(item, 128, 128, 42, rl.WHITE)
delete(item)

item: string = "widget"
data := strings.clone_to_cstring(item)
rl.DrawText(data, 7, 7, 13, rl.WHITE)
delete(data)

data: string = "shadow"
result := strings.clone_to_cstring(data)
rl.DrawText(result, 42, 42, 100, rl.WHITE)
delete(result)

result: string = "gadget"
entry := strings.clone_to_cstring(result)
rl.DrawText(entry, 13, 13, 3, rl.WHITE)
delete(entry)

entry: string = "stone"
score := strings.clone_to_cstring(entry)
rl.DrawText(score, 100, 100, 9, rl.WHITE)
delete(score)

score: string = "storm"
size := strings.clone_to_cstring(score)
rl.DrawText(size, 3, 3, 25, rl.WHITE)
delete(size)
